title: The Coiled Coffer of Pyandonea
summary: Truce-captains at the Pyandonean Fleet Anchorage and Mistveil Village uncover storm-caste zealots plotting to overload the lightning spires above Storm-Caller's Spire and Orgnum's Citadel.

hook.rumour: Storm-caste zealots have seized the weather-vanes atop Storm-Caller's Spire, aiming to call a rogue tempest down on the neutral merchant anchorage at Mistveil Village.
hook.notice: PYANDONEAN FLEET ANCHORAGE: Envoys and deck-guards sought to secure the lightning conduits between Mistveil Village and Storm-Caller's Spire.

npcs.name: Warden of Pyandonean Fleet Anchorage
npcs.greet: Storm-caste zealots have seized the weather-vanes atop Storm-Caller's Spire, aiming to call a rogue tempest down on the neutral merchant anchorage at Mistveil Village.
talk: The trouble across the Maormer Isles of Pyandonea began when sealed dispatches started bypassing Pyandonean Fleet Anchorage.
If you mean to help the Truce-Harbour of Pyandonea, start by checking the trail between Pyandonean Fleet Anchorage and Storm Callers Spire.

npcs.name: Chronicler of Pyandonean Fleet Anchorage
npcs.greet: Keep your voice low—everyone at Storm Callers Spire is watching who asks after the old seals.
talk: We traced the couriers from Storm Callers Spire toward Orgnums Citadel before they vanished into the brush.
Bring any ciphered tallies back to Pyandonean Fleet Anchorage so Truce-CaptainVaronis can see the proof.

npcs.name: Outrider of Orgnums Citadel
npcs.greet: You made good time from Storm Callers Spire. The saboteurs have fortified the approaches near Mistveil Village.
talk: Their ringleader is holding the inner chamber at Mistveil Village with a picked guard.
Once Mistveil Village is cleared, return to Pyandonean Fleet Anchorage to seal the regional compact.

npcs.name: Speaker of Pyandonean Fleet Anchorage
npcs.greet: Truce-CaptainVaronis awaits word on whether the crisis in the Maormer Isles of Pyandonea has been contained.
talk: The elders of Pyandonean Fleet Anchorage have prepared the concord table for your return.
All of the Maormer Isles of Pyandonea owes you a debt for standing between Pyandonean Fleet Anchorage and ruin.
